correctness.rationale: For all p and e the smooth-plane canonical basis has q(q+1)/2 monomials. Direct trinomial expansion and Stöhr–Voloch extraction leave at most one coefficient per source, with nonzero multinomial mod p and injective target mapping. The surviving initial r digit positions satisfy independent no-carry conditions; exact counting gives rho_r=T^r p^(e-r)(p^(e-r)+1)/2. This is an all-parameter proof independent of finite checks. The independent standalone coefficient enumerator reproduced the transition and every predicted rank for tested cases; none of those tests was used as a proof for arbitrary p,e.

value.rationale: The complete filtration refines an archived one-step a-number result on a classical, naturally indexed Hurwitz family. It determines p-rank in all prime-power degrees and every nilpotent string-length count, including nontrivial additional Cartier rank drops for e>=3. Such data controls the stable-vs-nilpotent part of the Jacobian’s mod-p cohomology, which cannot be read from the genus or single-step a-number. It is an infinite exact structural classification rather than an arbitrary finite slice or cosmetic restatement.
